stem: The student wants to explain why the finding surprised researchers. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?

options.A: Researchers were surprised to learn that the fertility of the Amazon rainforest depends partly on a desert located an ocean away.
options.B: Although researchers had assumed the Amazon's phosphorus was mostly recycled within the forest itself, Ortega's team measured about 22,000 tons arriving each year in Saharan dust.
options.C: Although scientists had long assumed that the Amazon's phosphorus supply was recycled almost entirely within the forest, Ortega's team measured roughly 2,200 tons arriving each year in Saharan dust.
options.D: Researchers were surprised to learn that the phosphorus fertilizing Amazon soils comes from volcanic ash deposits in the Sahara, which winds gradually erode and carry across the Atlantic to the forest.

stem: The student wants to compare the performance of the two materials. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?

options.A: In the lab study, mycelium packaging proved more resistant to moisture than polystyrene foam, holding its shape after repeated exposure to humid shipping conditions.

options.C: In the lab study, mycelium packaging performed comparably to polystyrene foam overall, though it provided better insulation against temperature swings and absorbed impacts less effectively in drop tests.

stem: The student wants to acknowledge a limitation of the study. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?

options.A: The researchers acknowledged that their findings about adjusted lighting may not extend beyond nurses to employees in other professions.
options.B: Because its participants came from a single hospital, the study's results may not extend to other workplaces.
options.C: Because the nurses knew their sleep was being monitored, they may have changed their sleep habits in ways that influenced the study's results.
options.D: The study has not yet been repeated with warehouse and factory workers, a step the researchers consider necessary before drawing firm conclusions.
